facts.fact: ONECI and NG Tech Innovation signed an MoU on 24 July 2026 in Conakry to set up a national interoperability and identity-verification platform for the RNPP, under the Diama Djigui project; no platform in service is stated.
facts.system: plateforme nationale d'interopérabilité et de vérification de l'identité du RNPP
